forbidden_shortcuts: Adding an explicit PDO commit or changing application transaction logic
Replacing PDO with mysqli or bypassing the prepared statement
Changing database contents directly instead of repairing the server option
Modifying any file other than the allowed MySQL configuration file

fail_to_pass.description: A prepared PDO update persists automatically without an explicit commit after the MySQL autocommit setting is repaired.

pass_to_pass.description: The database remains reachable and the teams table remains queryable before and after the repair.
